summary.text: Mike Klein is a no-party-affiliation candidate for Florida's 3rd District. A fifth-generation Floridian raised in Gainesville, he is a West Point graduate and Army combat veteran who served from 1985 to 2003. He is chairman of Warrior Centric Health and is running on a platform of removing corporate and special-interest money from politics.

paragraphs.text: According to his campaign survey, he is a fifth-generation Floridian raised in Gainesville in the 1970s.
Graduated from the U.S. Military Academy at West Point in 1989 and later earned a graduate degree from the University of South Carolina's Darla Moore School of Business.
Served in the U.S. Army from 1985 to 2003; he says he was a Ranger-qualified Infantry officer in the 25th Infantry Division who led soldiers in combat in Operation Desert Storm.
Says he has worked and lived internationally, building expertise in international business, economic development, university innovation and entrepreneurship.

Co-founded and chairs Warrior Centric Health, which he says works to improve care for the military and veteran community; he says he started it after his brother, an Army infantry officer, lost limbs to an IED.
Is running as an independent; he describes himself as the father of two "Gators" and says he has pledged not to take corporate PAC or special-interest money.
